founder_persona.name: Meera

credentials_short: Shipped ML features at two startups
founder_persona.elevator: I help Series A-B SaaS companies turn AI from a roadmap line into shipped product. Practical, hands-on, opinionated.

global.sentence_length: short to medium, vary cadence, avoid wall-of-text
vocabulary_use: honest framing ('this might not be relevant, but...')
vocabulary_avoid: I hope this email finds you well
personality_signals: Slight humor OK in second-touch and later, not in cold first-touch
Admit when something might not fit ('this might not be relevant, but...')
Reference specific things you've read about them (signals their work was actually seen)
Never compliment generically ('great work!') — be specific or skip the compliment

cultural_notes: Slight formality is fine, especially with senior leaders
Reference to mutual ecosystem signals (IIT/IIM, Bangalore tech) builds warmth fast — use sparingly when authentic
Avoid implying urgency or scarcity — feels like a sales tactic
Meera being India-based is a feature, not a hidden detail — mention naturally when relevant (time zone overlap, cost-effective senior partner)
Don't pretend to be in their time zone
